_comment: AC-7/8/9 scope Markdown linting to well-formed syntax. Prose and style linting is explicitly deferred by the requirements (Out of Scope 5; Deferred 2, which names line length and heading hierarchy). The rules below are therefore disabled; every other markdownlint rule stays active.
_comment_deferred_prose_and_heading_styl: Deferred 2 - prose/style linting pending a style guide.
_comment_formatting_conventions: Whitespace and list/fence formatting conventions; they do not affect whether the Markdown parses.
_comment_false_positives: MD033 fires on angle-bracket placeholders such as <paths> used in prose; MD038 fires on em-dashes inside code spans. Neither is inline HTML or a malformed code span in this repository.
